nodes.label: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
nodes.author: Zheyuan Zhang, Alvin Zhang, Daniel Khashabi, Tianmin Shu

nodes.label: Long-Horizon Memorization Problem
nodes.rationale: Formalized as a distinct continual learning challenge where models learn 100 query-answer tasks through sequential fine-tuning without retaining raw examples or receiving task identifiers at inference.

nodes.label: Data Anchor: Unconditional Generative Replay
nodes.rationale: Preserves earlier task information by training on replayed sequences generated from a frozen previous model, using a task-agnostic replay token.

nodes.label: Function Anchor: Self-Distillation
nodes.rationale: Constrains model output distributions on current-task inputs by matching predictions with a frozen previous model, following Learning without Forgetting.

nodes.label: Weight Anchor: Importance-Based Regularization
nodes.rationale: Limits parameter changes based on estimated importance for previously learned behavior, instantiated via Synaptic Intelligence (SI) and Online EWC.

nodes.label: Merged LoRA: Low-Rank Allocation Rule
nodes.rationale: Folds each task's LoRA update into the dense model before initializing a new adapter, enabling multiple low-rank updates while maintaining constant state size.

nodes.label: Task-Level Successive Halving (TSH)
nodes.rationale: Search procedure that progressively increases task horizons (10→20→50→100) and ranks configurations by retention, reducing computational cost by 71.8% versus exhaustive search.

nodes.label: Symbol-QA Dataset
nodes.rationale: 100 tasks with 10,000 random key-value associations; tests memorization of arbitrary associations without semantic structure.

nodes.label: LLM-QA Dataset
nodes.rationale: 100 tasks with 10,000 LLM-generated fictional facts across topics; tests memorization with natural language and familiar entity types.

nodes.label: Real-QA Dataset
nodes.rationale: 100 tasks with 5,000 natural questions from 10 public QA datasets, filtered to exclude base-model knowledge; tests memorization of real facts.

nodes.label: 2^4 Factorial Experiment
nodes.rationale: Systematic evaluation of all 16 combinations of three anchors and merged LoRA to measure individual and interaction effects on final retention.

nodes.label: Catastrophic Forgetting Problem
nodes.rationale: Central challenge in continual learning where sequential updates cause loss of previously learned knowledge; naive fine-tuning achieves only 1.2% retention after 100 tasks.

nodes.label: Memory Half-Life Metric
nodes.rationale: Measures memory decay by counting tasks until retention falls below 50%; naive fine-tuning: 1-2 tasks, best composition: 19-44 tasks.

nodes.label: Super-Additive Interaction: Replay × Merged LoRA
nodes.rationale: Replay and merged LoRA interact super-additively on all three datasets; combined gains far exceed sum of standalone contributions (e.g., 31.0 vs 7.7 points on LLM-QA).
